## The LOG button was quietly dead the whole time

Turns out the touch redesign in v1.0.8 (edge-zone backgrounds, Squachy's tap/hold/pet gestures) had a bug that made the LOG and CLR buttons on the main screen completely unreachable by touch — any tap that wasn't in an edge zone or the onboarding bubble got swallowed by the Squachy-gesture check, whether it actually landed on him or not, and the button bar never got a turn. Found it while chasing an unrelated 3.5"-board touch issue and reflashing v1.0.8 for a sanity check — worth a hotfix on its own since it shipped to everyone on the last release.

### The actually-useful part
- **Fixed**: LOG and CLR buttons on the main screen are reachable by touch again — a regression introduced by v1.0.8's edge-zone/gesture redesign, present in that release
